# Kconfig - architecture-independent configuration options
#
# Copyright (c) 2017 Intel Corporation
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

config CPU_HAS_FPU
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the CPU has a hardware floating point unit.

config CPU_HAS_MMU_MPU
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the CPU has a memory management unit (MMU)
	  or a memory protection unit (MPU).

config ARCH_HAS_USERSPACE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports user mode and
	  memory domains.

config ARCH_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has timing functions
	  implemented.

config ARCH_HAS_STACK_PROTECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has stack protection
	  (e.g. stack canaries) feature.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_ABORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has the ability to abort
	  a thread.

config ARCH_HAS_RAMFUNC_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports RAM Functions.
	  RAM functions are functions that are copied from ROM to RAM at boot
	  time and are executed from RAM.

config ARCH_HAS_CPU_IDLE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has implemented CPU idle.

config ARCH_HAS_NANO_TIMEOUT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a nano timeout
	  implementation.

config ARCH_HAS_SWAP
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has implemented the
	  context swap.

config ARCH_HAS_GDBSTUB
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has GDB stub support.

config ARCH_SUPPORTS_COOP_PREEMPT_TIMERS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports cooperative and
	  preemptive timers.

config ARCH_HAS_CUSTOM_SWAP_TO_MAIN
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a custom swap to main
	  thread implementation.

config ARCH_HAS_CUSTOM_BUSY_WAIT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a custom busy wait
	  implementation.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports thread local
	  storage.

config ARCH_HAS_LAZY_REG_STACK_SWITCH
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports lazy register
	  stack switching.

config ARCH_HAS_DEMAND_PAGING
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports demand paging.

config ARCH_HAS_RESERVED_PAGE_FRAMES
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports reserved page
	  frames.

config ARCH_HAS_EXECUTABLE_PAGE_WRITES
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports executable page
	  writes.

config ARCH_HAS_COVERAGE_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has coverage support.

config ARCH_HAS_SYSCALL_INLINE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports inline system
	  calls.

config ARCH_HAS_ADDITIONAL_CRITICAL_REGIONS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has additional critical
	  regions.

config ARCH_STACK_PTR_TYPE
	string
	help
	  This option specifies the type of the stack pointer.

config ARCH_MEM_DOMAIN_DATA
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has memory domain data.

config ARCH_MEM_DOMAIN_SYNCHRONOUS_API
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a synchronous memory
	  domain API.

config GEN_ISR_TABLES
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture generates ISR tables.

config GEN_SW_ISR_TABLE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture generates a software ISR
	  table.

config GEN_IRQ_VECTOR_TABLE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture generates an IRQ vector
	  table.

config ISR_STACK_SIZE
	int "ISR stack size"
	default 2048
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the ISR stack.

config ARCH_IRQ_VECTOR_TABLE_ALIGN
	int "IRQ vector table alignment"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the alignment of the IRQ vector table.

config PLATFORM_STACK_SIZE_OFFSET
	int "Platform stack size offset"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the offset of the platform stack size.

config EXCEPTION_STACK_SIZE
	int "Exception stack size"
	default 2048
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the exception stack.

config ARCH_EXCEPT
	bool "Architecture-specific exception handling"
	help
	  This option enables architecture-specific exception handling.

config HAS_ESF
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an exception stack
	  frame.

config TEST_EXTRA_STACKSIZE
	int "Extra stack size for tests"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the extra stack size for tests.

config KOBJECT_TEXT_AREA
	int "Kobject text area size"
	default 256
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the kobject text area.

config THREAD_CUSTOM_DATA_SIZE
	int "Size of custom data area in kernel thread"
	default 0
	depends on THREAD_CUSTOM_DATA
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the custom data area in the kernel
	  thread structure.

config CUSTOM_SECTION_MIN_ALIGN_SIZE
	int "Minimum alignment for custom sections"
	default 4
	help
	  This option specifies the minimum alignment for custom sections.

config HW_STACK_PROTECTION
	bool "Hardware-based stack protection"
	depends on ARCH_HAS_STACK_PROTECTION
	help
	  Enable hardware-based stack protection. This option is only available
	  on architectures that support it.

config STACK_POINTER_RANDOM
	int "Stack pointer randomization"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the amount of stack pointer randomization.

config STACK_GROWS_UP
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the stack grows up.

config SCHED_IPI_SUPPORTED
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports scheduler IPIs.

config DISABLE_IRQ_STATISTICS
	bool "Disable IRQ statistics"
	help
	  This option disables IRQ statistics.

config DISABLE_SYSCALL_STATS
	bool "Disable syscall statistics"
	help
	  This option disables syscall statistics.

config TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	bool "Enable timing functions"
	depends on ARCH_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	help
	  This option enables timing functions.

config ARCH_TIMING_STAT_HZ
	int "Timing statistics frequency"
	default 1000000
	depends on TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	help
	  This option specifies the frequency of the timing statistics.

config ARCH_TIMING_STAT_DIV
	int "Timing statistics divisor"
	default 1
	depends on TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	help
	  This option specifies the divisor of the timing statistics.

config ARCH_TIMING_FUNCTIONS_NEED_AT_BOOT
	bool "Timing functions needed at boot"
	depends on TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	help
	  This option indicates that the timing functions are needed at boot.

config ARCH_HAS_CYCLE_COUNTER
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cycle counter.

config TIMER_READS_ITS_FREQUENCY_AT_RUNTIME
	bool "Timer reads its frequency at runtime"
	help
	  This option indicates that the timer reads its frequency at runtime.

config CPU_CLOCK_FREQUENCY
	int "CPU clock frequency"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the CPU clock frequency.

config CPU_CYCLES_PER_SEC
	int "CPU cycles per second"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the number of CPU cycles per second.

config XIP
	bool "Execute in place"
	help
	  This option enables execute in place.

config LINKER_USE_BOOT_HEADER
	bool "Use boot header"
	help
	  This option enables the use of a boot header.

config LINKER_GENERIC_SECTIONS_PRESENT_AT_BOOT
	bool "Generic sections present at boot"
	help
	  This option indicates that the generic sections are present at boot.

config LINKER_SORT_BY_ALIGNMENT
	bool "Sort linker sections by alignment"
	help
	  This option enables sorting of linker sections by alignment.

config LINKER_SORT_BY_NAME
	bool "Sort linker sections by name"
	help
	  This option enables sorting of linker sections by name.

config SRAM_SIZE
	int "SRAM size"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the SRAM.

config SRAM_BASE_ADDRESS
	hex "SRAM base address"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the base address of the SRAM.

config FLASH_SIZE
	int "Flash size"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the flash.

config FLASH_BASE_ADDRESS
	hex "Flash base address"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the base address of the flash.

config CODE_DATA_RELOCATION
	bool "Code and data relocation"
	help
	  This option enables code and data relocation.

config LINKER_USE_ROM_REGION
	bool "Use ROM region"
	help
	  This option enables the use of a ROM region.

config BOOT_BANNER
	bool "Show boot banner"
	default y
	help
	  This option enables the display of a boot banner.

config BOOT_DELAY
	int "Boot delay"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the boot delay in milliseconds.

config IDLE_STACK_SIZE
	int "Idle thread stack size"
	default 320
	help
	  This option specifies the stack size of the idle thread.

config MAIN_STACK_SIZE
	int "Main thread stack size"
	default 1024
	help
	  This option specifies the stack size of the main thread.

config PRIVILEGED_STACK_SIZE
	int "Privileged thread stack size"
	default 1024
	depends on USERSPACE
	help
	  This option specifies the stack size of a privileged thread.

config MAX_THREAD_BYTES
	int "Maximum bytes for thread data"
	depends on USERSPACE
	default 4
	help
	  Maximum number of bytes for a thread's data object. This is used
	  for validation purposes when creating threads. The default is 4,
	  which is the minimum required for the thread's entry point and
	  argument.

config MINIMAL_LIBC_MALLOC_ARENA_SIZE
	int "Minimal libc malloc arena size"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the minimal libc malloc arena.

config MINIMAL_LIBC_CALLOC_ARENA_SIZE
	int "Minimal libc calloc arena size"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the minimal libc calloc arena.

config MINIMAL_LIBC_REALLOC_ARENA_SIZE
	int "Minimal libc realloc arena size"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the minimal libc realloc arena.

config MINIMAL_LIBC_FREE_ARENA_SIZE
	int "Minimal libc free arena size"
	default 0
	help
	  This option specifies the size of the minimal libc free arena.
